SPONSOR WITH INTENT
Sponsorship at Ember Vector Works is small by design.

No keynote sales pitches, no logo wallpaper. We cap each tier, write program copy together, and share attention reports the week after the event. If that sounds like your kind of partnership, the prospectus is a short read.

Request the prospectus Email the partnerships team
What partners get
A written sponsor brief, co-edited with our editorial team
Onsite booth in the Mezzanine, all three days
Attendee opt-in lead capture (no scraping)
Post-event recap with demographics and feedback quotes
Invitation to the sponsors dinner on opening night
